rules: Two hours a day, five days a week. A missed day is not a missed week.
Every session ends with a note: command, result, next question.
No tool without a hypothesis. No finding without a reproduction.
Read the primary source before the YouTube summary.
Redo one old lab each week from memory.
Publish one writeup a month. Feedback is part of the loop.
